facts.fact: ST DIGITAL says its DLA01 data centre in Douala houses DOUALA-IX, an open, neutral peering point whose members include AFRI-IX Telecom, CAMIX NAP, INQ Digital Cameroon SA, Opex Network and SWECOM; it holds IXP OIX-1 certification from the Open-IX Association (no date given for the service, so the 2024-09-11 publication date is used; no member count given).

note: One service fact; no traffic figure, content network, second city or foreign members named.
